title: Stay Away At All Cost
body: I downloaded it an paid around ¥2,000 so I could try it but before I could use it it tried charging me an additional ¥5,000, then it successfully charged me ¥6,000 again. It caught me off guard because by then it’s already 13,000 in less than 2 weeks of using this app. They make it so it’s difficult for you to find where the hidden charges came from and it all looks legit but it actually isn’t! If my credit card company didn’t double check with me I never would’ve known they’d taken that much from my account. I cancelled my prepayment with them but just today they tried taking ¥5,000+ again from my bank. Then when I tried using the app today I was automatically logged out of it. It is fraudulent, scammy and preys on people who wants to improve their lives. STAY WAY AT ALL COSTS

title: How not to build habits: Terrible or sneaky billing and poor app interface
body:
A not so Fabulous experience. 

This is a terrible app to use for building habits, the user interface is poor on the iPhone and the activities come across as pseudo/pop psychology - empty prompts, poor daily couching and a very incoherent app flow. Spent more time trying to navigate it than actually building good habits.

The billing is also sneaky, they hook you with a trial and then bill you without confirming if you want to continue. When asked for a refund, I was convincingly outside of the geographical region for them. 

So money down the drain, no refund, account deleted and definitely do not recommend it. 

Buy a nice journal and work on yourself without the stress. 

Don’t aim for the Fabulous life, find balance in your own way.

title: Awesome but too glitchy to use.
body:
I have wasted hours of time instead of gaining productivity, because the app keeps glitching out. 

I’m using an iPhone 12 Pro Max. 
Restart app? Not fixed. 
Restart phone? Not fixed. 
Delete and reinstall app? 
Endless onboarding nightmare before it lets me touch the settings, and even then, I can’t get it back to where I was because elements are “locked” until I progress to them AGAIN. 
I already finished so much, and started joining live challenges, and now I can’t even see any challenges at all. 

Give me back my status on this app. 

The backup function? A joke. It backed up my new worthless position before I could reinstall my backup from before reinstalling. 

Maybe if I didn’t have to go through 30 min of stupid onboarding, I could have gone straight to backups and installed the right one. 

When it works, it is the best app I ever used for productivity. 

When it doesn’t it drains away the time from my day. 

It is doing exactly the opposite of the purpose I paid for.

The team told me they couldn’t give my money back as it was mentioned in the App Store like every other app. Except I never had a problem like this with other apps. Clearly forced me to pay.
Nevertheless, as I paid I start using the app more seriously. It’s a bit boring and not really motivating. Your challenge like water every morning is useless and some of them like try to reduce your phone use when the app is reminding you to take your phone at least 3 times a day to look at this app is also ineffective. The application could be great but even if you pay for a year they ask you for a life plan. It's all about the money. And the app is not really worth this money. Others are more likely to be useful.
